# lokgou Official LLM Context Index

Load only the source needed for the current task. Do not preload complete vendor documentation.

## Bun

- Official index: https://bun.sh/llms.txt
- Use for runtime APIs, `Bun.password`, files, workspaces, package scripts, and `bun:test`.
- Focus: https://bun.com/docs/runtime/hashing.md, https://bun.com/docs/test/index.md, https://bun.com/docs/pm/workspaces.md

## Elysia

- Official index: https://elysiajs.com/llms.txt
- Use for routing, guards, lifecycle, validation, errors, plugin composition, JWT, OpenAPI, and testing.
- Focus: https://elysiajs.com/essential/validation.md, https://elysiajs.com/tutorial/getting-started/guard.md, https://elysiajs.com/plugins/jwt.md, https://elysiajs.com/plugins/openapi.md

## Prisma

- Official index: https://www.prisma.io/llms.txt
- Full context: https://www.prisma.io/llms-full.txt
- Read `apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma` before database changes. Use `bun run db:generate`, `bun run db:push`, and `bun run db:seed`.

## Zod

- Official index: https://zod.dev/llms.txt
- Use for schemas, coercion, error customization, `zod/locales`, and JSON Schema.
- Focus: https://zod.dev/api, https://zod.dev/error-customization, https://zod.dev/json-schema

## Scalar

- Official index: https://scalar.com/llms.txt
- Use for API Reference auth, configuration, OpenAPI extensions, and request testing.
- Focus: https://scalar.com/products/api-references/configuration/index.md, https://scalar.com/products/api-client/authentication/index.md

## Faker

- Faker has no official `llms.txt` endpoint at this time.
- Official API docs: https://fakerjs.dev/api/
- Keep seed data deterministic with `faker.seed(...)` and generate business IDs through persisted AutoCode rules.

## Order

1. Read local conventions and affected code.
2. Fetch the focused official source above.
3. Verify installed package types and lockfile version when APIs may have changed.
4. Run `bun run quality` after code changes.
